intro: The Loading Room is an industrial staging chamber inside Gnomeregan's sprawling mechanical complex. In the current era, this subterranean staging area lies deep within the corrupted fallen capital, dangerously close to rogue constructs such as Techbot.

p: Before the fall of Gnomeregan, the Loading Room functioned as a bustling transit point and cargo staging bay linked to the subterranean transit networks of the tinker capital. Today, like the rest of the ruined city, it has succumbed to chaos. Radioactive fallout, invading troggs, and malfunctioning machinery have rendered the area extremely perilous. The rogue mechanized construct Techbot guards the vicinity, posing a severe threat to any gnome survivors or daring Alliance reclaimers attempting to secure the perimeter.
